wardrobe.notes: The shared avatar's wardrobe (brief section 3): cosmetic only, never stats. Each piece switches on one skinned mesh in Avatar.fbx and tints one material with the slot's colourway. rgb values are sRGB 0-1. The rib material (cuffs, hems) is tinted 25% darker than fabric_main by the wardrobe code. The head, eyes and base body are always on.
